item.title: The Battle of Bosworth Field, 22 Aug 1485

item.title: Medieval dungeon found under Leicester market square
item.description: Beneath a city square in the English city of Leicester, archaeologists have discovered a Roman infant burial, remnants of medieval commerce and a 16th-century civic building’s foundations. Experts think the latter is the bygone Gainsborough Chamber, which was first recorded in the 1500s and home to a dungeon once described as “a most vile prison.” […]
